newsitem.title: UK: HK stocks in London steady in featureless trade.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks in London steady in featureless trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in London were mostly unchanged on Monday as investors paused for breath following a volatile Hong Kong session earlier in the day, dealers said.

The Hong Kong London Reference index eased 2.19 points to close at 15,019.04. In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng index fell 133.13 to finish at 15,021.23, having earlier risen 167 points to a new all-time high of 15,322.
Dealers said investors had little incentive to open fresh positions in London with no key economic data expected from the U.S. this week.

"I think we will see the London market remain around current levels for the next couple of days and then maybe see a small rally at the end of the week as the handover (to China) approaches," said one dealer.
